title: The Unfinished Arch
summary: Hesk Ironbrow never finished his Durrow guild test arch. Cut the stone at Hollin's Cut and set the arch before Odrin Thale in Silverford, round or Charter-form.
offer_text: My test arch. Twelve cut stones, a keystone, and the nerve to set it in front of Odrin Thale. It never got finished.

objectives.text: Walk Hesk to the quarry at Hollin's Cut

options.text: Set it pointed, in Charter form
options.say: Hesk spits on his palms. "Pointed. Fine. Hold the keystone steady, then."

options.text: Set it round, the Durrow way
options.say: Hesk grins, all gravel. "Round it is. Grandfather would've wept."

objectives.text: Set the pointed arch before the Masons' and Runecarvers' Guild hall

relationship.label: You let him finish it in the Charter's form

objectives.text: Set the round arch before the Masons' and Runecarvers' Guild hall

relationship.label: You let him cut it round
